Cover every sentence once; do not skip, merge or reorder.

CAUTIONS. A sentence that reports a number, a quoted string, a hash, or the absence of something can still be NOT load-bearing if the conclusion would stand without it. A sentence with no number can be LOAD-BEARING. Use UNSURE honestly; it is counted against the panel, not against you. Do not reproduce the passage; quote only the opening and closing three words.
